docs(plan): the only hard-coded limits are the providers'; every other limit is the person's

The owner, 2026-10-17: "the limits we set on our agents hardcoded are
ONLY the limit set from the providers, which means they will be different
for each model provider" and "the limits are supposed to be setable in the
app to prevent overconsumption or use".

PLAN.md's designs carried limits written before that rule, and every job
and summary that read them brought them back. Each one is now either a
limit or threshold the person sets (none by default), the provider's own
limit for that model from its capability record, or removed: team worker,
task, minute, request, queue, board, reassignment, depth and budget
defaults; the 20-agent "hard ceiling" and the guess for external agents;
the 30-minute cooldown and 60-minute queue wait; brief, clarification and
search-hit caps; the paid, Tab and team daily budget defaults; Tab's open
and per-minute caps, hook timeout and output caps; web search's 5 per
request; headless output capped below the model's maximum; the resource
governor on by default with fixed thresholds; disk governance on by
default; the MCP form deadline; question count, defer and reminder caps;
report retention caps; held-checkout caps and lock waits; Muse Node's caps
and quotas; media upload size, expiry and recording length.

Model-platform limits (context, output, rate limits, plan windows) stay,
and are being researched provider by provider and model by model.
